'''Incomplete article.''' The Japanese card face is shown. Fields awaiting verification are marked below.

== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ライトセーバー修得</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-54o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">能力値＞２でライトセーバーを持つキャラクターに配備する。キャラクターは、戦闘力が＋３され、いるロケーションのフォース消耗に＋１される。キャラクターがライトセーバーをなくせば、このエフェクトはロストする。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">ジェダイが学ぶのは、ただライトセーバーを振るうだけでなく、フォースを通わせて技を磨き、セーバーの威力を制御することである。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title:''' Lightsaber Training.

'''Card text:''' Deploy on a character with ability greater than 2 who has a lightsaber. The character is power +3, and their location is Force drain +1. If the character loses the lightsaber, this Effect is lost.

'''Lore:''' A Jedi learns to do more than swing a lightsaber. They refine their technique through the Force and learn to control the saber's power.

== Statistics ==
* '''Destiny:''' 4
* '''Printed subtype:''' Effect
* '''Uniqueness:''' Unique (one marker)

Remaining printed symbols and statistics await verification.<ref name="jp-face" />
